document_notes: The page contains the continuation of the entry for C. Avidius Nigrinus (lemma on the preceding page) and the beginning of the entry for his daughter Avidia Plautia.

entries.relevance_notes: Explicitly identified as 'Legatus Aug. pr. pr.' of Moesia superior and 'legati Aug. pro praetore' of Achaia.

segments.offices_and_career: Consul suffectus a. inc. sub Traiano. Consularis. Legatus Aug. pr. pr. Moesiae superioris potius quam Daciae. Legatus in Achaiam ad ordinandum vel corrigendum statum rerum publicarum.
segments.governorship_attestation: Legatus Aug. pr. pr. t. 8 Moesiae superioris potius quam Daciae (quod statuerunt Dessau aliique); nam etsi titulus positus est Sarmizegetusae, ex mentione legionis IIII Flaviae, quae in Moesia superiore tendebat, apparere videtur Nigrinum huius provinciae legatum fuisse. Tempus legationis... a. 117/118 ab Hadriano e provincia avocatum.
segments.family_and_social_relations: Hadrianus eum successorem sibimet destinavit... Sacrificanti Hadriano insidias paravit conscio sibi Lusio (Quieto) et multis aliis... Faventiae occisus a. 118. Father of Avidia Plautia.
segments.prosopographical_commentary: Discussion of his legation in Achaia (Mommsen CIL III p. 107, L. Aemilius Iuncus n. 355) and Moesia superior vs Dacia (Premerstein, Ritterling).
segments.bibliography_or_cross_references: Mommsen CIL III p. 107; L. Aemilio Iunco n. 355; Premerstein Klio Bhft. 8 p. 10 sq.; Ritterling RE 12, 1544; Journ. Rom. St. 1914, 13; Weber Untersuch. 2. Geschichte d. Kaisers Hadrian p. 78.

governorship_factoids.exact_text: Legatus Aug. pr. pr. t. 8 Moesiae superioris potius quam Daciae
notes: Premerstein argued he was recalled from the province in 117/118 by Hadrian.

governorship_factoids.exact_text: Nigrinum missum esse legatum in Achaiam ad ordinandum vel corrigendum statum rerum publicarum ... legati Aug. pro praetore extra ordinem Achaiam provinciam proconsulis loco regebant
notes: Mommsen's view of him being sent to Achaia to order/correct the state of public affairs.

career_factoids.exact_text: Consul suffectus a. inc. sub Traiano

related_persons.relation_context: Recalled Nigrinus from province, designated him successor, then executed him.

relations.relation: designated successor of (initially), then conspirator against
relations.basis: Hadrianus eum successorem sibimet destinavit... Sacrificanti Hadriano insidias paravit

entry_notes: The entry is a continuation from the previous page, but contains the critical governorship attestations for Moesia Superior and Achaia.
